_comment: #493: the frozen app-web URL tree — the inner-tree counterpart of tools/route_manifest.json (which only assigns service PREFIXES). tests/route-tree-freeze.test.ts fails when a filesystem route exists that is not listed here, when a live route is missing, or when a planned route gets built without flipping it to live in the same PR. Planned entries are the approved-but-unbuilt pages from the 4-step overhaul (#494/#495); adding any route outside this contract requires amending this file, visibly, in the same PR.
